findings.text: the launch-path search filters candidates by the incidental 'plan in symbols' test and then asserts only that a non-supervised launcher calls one of plan_dispatch/resume_* or change_lane. A launch path added later that spawns a worker via a name outside {_spawn, _start_supervisor}, or that spawns without a Name 'plan' in scope, is never collected, so done-when item 2's guarantee ('a launch path added later without the gate read fails the test') holds only for the exact shape the filter admits; the trailing assert that '_dispatch_fleet_gate' appears in dispatch.py's text is a tautology because the definition sits in that file. I verified the search over the head tree collects four launchers (cli.py:crew_resume, dispatch.py:dispatch, dispatch.py:supervised_launch, resumption.py:_resume), each of which passes.

done-when item 1 pairs each launching path's held assertion with 'a control finds the same call admitted once the gate is open'. The open-control exists only on the dispatch path (test_gate_command_prints_both_documents_and_dispatch_waits admits a dry-run dispatch with exit 0 after --open). resume (test_resume_checks_the_shared_gate_before_building_a_launch) and redispatch (test_redispatch_checks_the_shared_gate_before_stopping_the_source) assert only the held direction, so their admitted-when-open direction is untested and a guard that refused unconditionally would still pass those two.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 5d270a38: one commit f355dc83 modifies cli.py and dispatch.py and adds the test module; the fleet read is inserted ahead of the backend gate in _dispatch_lane_gate and ahead of worktree creation in plan_dispatch/resume_plan/change_lane/supervised_launch.

item_verdicts.goal: The fleet-wide gate holds launches across every backend: dispatch, resume, redispatch and supervised_launch each read it, and recovery/reflex paths reach it through plan_dispatch/resume_plan/change_lane; readings, completion and promotion are untouched.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, head f355dc83, base 5d270a38, after_suite (gate-arm.log) 28 passed/EXIT=0, negative_control_log declared, baseline_suite empty; commit body present and conventional.
item_verdicts.write_paths: diff touches exactly reckon/cli.py, reckon/crew/dispatch.py and tests/test_the_fleet_gate_holds_dispatch.py, all inside the manifest fence; the two declared fragment/figure paths were not produced and are not required by the plan section.

justifications.durability: the guards fail on regression and one was demonstrated: skipping the fleet read in dispatch reddens the held-dispatch test (negative-control.log, EXIT=1), and test_backend_gate_still_holds_when_fleet_gate_is_open pins backend precedence. Deducted because the launch-path search's filter and tautology (finding 1) and the missing resume/redispatch open-controls (finding 2) leave two of done-when's guarantees pinned only in the held direction.
justifications.evidence: the gate is recorded and reproduces: gate-arm.log names revision f355dc83 and reports 28 passed EXIT=0, and negative-control.log shows the declared mutation (skip the fleet read) reddens test_dispatch_rejects_a_paused_fleet_document with EXIT=1. Deductions: the reviewed manifest names no baseline_suite log, so only the head arm is declared; and the admitted-once-open control (done-when 1) exists only for dispatch (finding 2).
justifications.fit: the change extends the existing gate idiom: it reuses _gate_rows_from_payload and _read_text_under_deadline, matching the surrounding LanePaused/exit-75 handling in cli.py, and adds no plan, version, ticket or attribution identifier in names or comments; the fleet_gate_path and _dispatch_fleet_gate names describe their role.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the landed change holds every worker launch at once: _dispatch_fleet_gate is read before the backend gate in _dispatch_lane_gate (dispatch.py:4458) and directly in plan_dispatch (dispatch.py:5434), resume_plan (dispatch.py:12119), change_lane (dispatch.py:12513) and supervised_launch (dispatch.py:10023), and recovery.py:2742/2771/3825 reach those entry points, so the recover and reflex launches named by the section are held. Deducted because done-when item 2's search guarantee is narrower than the section states (finding 1).
justifications.reuse: no capability is forked: the fleet gate is read through the same _dispatch_lane_gate owner it extends (dispatch.py:4456) and the same deadline/parse helpers, and the writer reuses write_json_atomically; the search over reckon/ found no pre-existing fleet-wide gate owner that this duplicates.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-status 5d270a38..f355dc83 lists exactly M reckon/cli.py, M reckon/crew/dispatch.py and A tests/test_the_fleet_gate_holds_dispatch.py; all three sit inside the manifest fence (reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/cli.py, tests/test_the_fleet_gate_holds_dispatch.py) and the commit carries nothing the goal does not imply.
